title: Deterministic admission gauntlet and pin strategy for encoder↔reranker variants
creator: Connor Hayes
description: Context: We onboard multiple encoder and pairwise reranker artifacts (biencoders, cross-encoders, quantized variants) and need a deterministic admission path that produces reproducible performance profiles and a standard pinning strategy. This ticket establishes the 'admission gauntlet' (set of deterministic tests, workload sampling, and compatibility matrix) plus the metadata updates and publishing steps required to pin a model version to the catalog and publish its published performance profile. Goal is to reduce flakiness in profile releases, make rollbacks safe, and enable automated canaryting for downstream customers.
acceptance_criteria: Admission gauntlet test harness implemented and runnable via CI with a stable CLI (bench/gauntlet run --candidate <artifact>)
Compatibility matrix generator produces CSV/JSON artifact that lists supported runtimes, quantization modes, sequence length bands, expected throughput and P50/P95 latency
Pin strategy documented: pin metadata fields, semantic versioning rules for minor quality fixes vs. major architecture changes
Profile publishing workflow in Catalog automation produces deterministic published_profile.json with checksum and is signed by the release pipeline
Canary rollout recipe and automated rollback rule defined for Dedicated and Hosted traffic routing
At least two model artifacts (one biencoder and one cross-encoder) have been processed end-to-end and published to the staging catalog with profiles visible in the Console staging dashboard
steps: Design admission gauntlet test list (deterministic eval prompts, fixed RNG seeds, dataset slices). Constrain nondeterminism sources (model delta, CPU/GPU scheduling, batch ordering)
Implement bench/gauntlet harness in ml-infra repo; expose artifact collector that writes out profile artifacts to s3-staging
Add compatibility matrix generator that introspects model metadata (architecture, quant, ops) and runtime capabilities (kernel set) and outputs CSV/JSON
Update catalog service to accept 'pinned_version' and 'published_profile' with checksum + signing metadata
Create release pipeline step that runs gauntlet, gates on regressions against baseline, and publishes profile upon pass
Run manual onboarding for two candidate artifacts, iterate on failures, add mocks for flaky eval cases
Add canary routing policy in routing-service with fallback to baseline variant and automated alert on quality regression thresholds
risk_and_tradeoffs: Tight deterministic constraints (fixed seeds, controlled hardware) reduce coverage of real-world variability — we'll mitigate by running a secondary 'fuzz' harness in prod-like infra
Requiring signed published_profile increases release latency by ~10-15 minutes due to extra verification step — acceptable for stability but may impact urgent hotfix flows
Pinning too aggressively may stall updates to improved quantized variants; strategy documents must clarify policy for auto-updates vs manual pin increments
comments: 2025-11-19 Connor Hayes: Initial ticket created after sync with PM and research. Baseline artifacts: biencoder-v2-2025-11 and crossenc-compact-2025-10. Noted nondeterminism from tokenization differences across tokenizer versions.

2025-11-25 Aisha Patel: Implemented first pass of deterministic harness. Seed control and fixed batch ordering added. Found P95 variance > 20% on small batch sizes when GPU mixed precision is toggled. Added a gating rule to lock precision mode for gauntlet runs.

2025-12-09 Eng Lead (Marcos Li): Reviewed compatibility matrix schema. Request to include 'kernel_set' and 'cuda_compute_capability' columns. Also requested quantization metadata (int8 calibration method).

2025-12-22 Aisha Patel: Added compatibility CSV generator to bench tooling. Generated initial matrix for three candidates; uploaded to s3-staging as s3://redwood-staging/gauntlet/compatibility/matrix-2025-12-22.csv
2026-01-06 QA (Rina Suresh): End-to-end test failed due to missing 'signed_profile' field in catalog API. Catalog PR opened to accept signature metadata. See PR #211.
2026-01-20 SRE (Jamal Ortiz): Observed flakiness in staging runs correlated with node spin-up on batch jobs. Added ephemeral node warmup hook to bench runner to stabilize cold-start effects.
2026-01-29 Aisha Patel: First canary recipe drafted. Canary will route 2% of traffic to candidate for 24h; rollback if utility metrics (MAP@10 / recall@1) drop by >1.5% or latency P95 rises by >10%
2026-02-02 PM (Leah Nguyen): Approved canary thresholds for staging; requested a 'silent-canary' toggle to run traffic without exposing results to customers while validating metrics pipeline.

2026-02-10 Aisha Patel: Staging publish succeeded for biencoder-v2-2025-11. Cross-encoder requires minor tokenizer normalization fix. Next: close PRs, add signing step, and schedule Dedicated canary next week.
